I am old now, 75 years, but I still farm my 6 mu. My sons work in town, so I do most of the work with my wife. I cannot change much — I do what I did last year, what worked.

My land: I keep about 4.5 mu for wheat in winter and maize in summer — that is the main system here, everyone does it. The other 1.5 mu I still plant cotton, the way I always have, even though many neighbors gave it up. Cotton gives me cash if the price is fair.

**Wheat (winter, 4.5 mu):** I sow improved seed from the agro-shop, 济麦 type, what the dealer recommends. At sowing I put 1 bag of compound fertilizer (50 kg, 15-15-15) per mu — that is 7.5 kg each of N, P, K. In spring at jointing I top-dress 2 bags of urea per mu (about 100 kg urea = 46 kg N). Total nitrogen near 53 kg. Maybe a little much, but if I cut back and the wheat turns yellow I will lose more than the fertilizer cost. I water 4 times — winter water, jointing, heading, grain filling. Spray for weeds once, aphids once, sometimes scab once. Rotary till after maize harvest. I expect about 450 kg/mu.

**Maize (summer, 4.5 mu):** Hybrid seed, 郑单 type. Direct seed into wheat stubble, no plough — that is how everyone does it now, saves money. I put 1 bag compound at sowing (7.5-7.5-7.5) and top-dress 2 bags urea at big trumpet stage (46 kg N). Total ~53 N. Water 2 times if rain is short. Spray once for borer. Expect 500 kg/mu.

**Cotton (spring, 1.5 mu):** I use Bt cotton seed, the kind that resists bollworm — neighbors had good results years back. I plough this land, cotton wants deep soil. I put 1 bag compound + 1.5 bags urea (about 42 N, 7.5 P, 7.5 K). Water 3 times. Cotton needs many sprays — at least 5 times for aphids, mites, bollworm even with Bt. Expect 220 kg seed cotton/mu.

decision.reasoning_summary: I am 75 with primary schooling, so I farm the way that has fed my family for fifty years and copy what neighbors do. Wheat-maize on 4.5 mu is our main system — I use one bag of 15-15-15 compound at sowing and two bags of urea topdressing for each crop, because cutting back risks a yellow field and a bad harvest, and that loss is worse than a little wasted fertilizer. I keep 1.5 mu in Bt cotton out of habit and for cash, ploughing deep and spraying often because cotton pests never rest. I use well irrigation only when rain is short to save the electricity cost, and I buy improved or hybrid seed from the dealer because everyone here has seen these varieties yield well.
